params.1273: Add a log to a fire for additional Firemaking XP.
params.1274: Use a <col=FFFFFF>log</col> on a <col=FFFFFF>fire</col> to add a log to it. If you need more logs, you can chop down some trees.
params.1275: You can add to anyone's fire, but if you need to make a fire to stoke, just click a log in your inventory.
params.2225: It's better to stoke a fire than make a new one, and it may give you additional benefits.
